icons.note: Find an icon by its snake_case name on ➜  Icons.

kinds.instance_swap: swap the nested instance with setProperties({<prop>: componentId}); never detach
kinds.slot: Figma slot: place the listed components inside; never draw content
kinds.fixed_nested: nested instance with no swap property (a gap when it is an icon); set it through the nested instance, never detach
kinds.text_glyph: icon drawn as a text character (a gap)

slots.rule: Screens and Storybook controls must use these slots exactly. A needed swap that is missing is a component fix, not a reason to detach.
